debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting. Set to true for detailed logs.

log_file_path.description: Absolute path to the primary log file where fapolicyd writes events.

log_file_max.description: Maximum number of archived log files to retain during rotation.

log_file_size.description: Maximum size (in KB) per log file before rotation.

watched_dirs.description: List of directories whose file access events should be monitored for policy enforcement.

rule_allow_logging.description: Enable logging of file accesses that are explicitly allowed by policy.

rule_deny_logging.description: Enable logging of file accesses that are blocked (denied) by policy.

rule_enforce.description: Enable active enforcement of file access rules. When false, fapolicyd logs but does not block access.

trust_default_trust.description: Treat system binaries in standard paths as trusted by default (unless explicitly overridden).

trust_paths.description: List of directory paths whose contents are considered trusted (bypass enforcement).

kernel_block_unsigned_modules.description: Block loading of kernel modules that are not signed with a trusted key.

network_log_connections.description: Log network connections made by processes (if fapolicyd network support is enabled).

network_block_outbound.description: Block outbound network connections by default. Enable only in restrictive environments.

resources_max_fds.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors the fapolicyd daemon may hold.

resources_max_watches.description: Maximum number of inotify watches (file events) fapolicyd can monitor simultaneously.

server_workers.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 to auto-detect based on CPU cores.

server_foreground.description: Run fapolicyd in the foreground (for testing). Disable for production daemon mode.

server_pid_file.description: Absolute path for the PID file written by fapolicyd in daemon mode.

backend_use_audit.description: Use the kernel audit subsystem for event capture. Disable only if audit is unavailable.

order_rule_files.description: List of rule files to load in order (last one takes precedence for overlapping rules).

included_files.description: Additional configuration or rule files to include (e.g., custom policies). Each entry is a file path.
